title: DeliveryDefectTask
description: The `data` of the answer to `POST /delivery/v1/defect-tasks` (v0.59.0): the durable record of one defect-task creation. `201` for a new `operationKey`, `200` for a replay of the same key and body. `confirmed`: the issue exists and `issue` names it, `error` is `null`. `failed`: the service definitively did not create it, `issue` is `null` and `error` says why. `uncertain`: the create was sent and its outcome is unknown, `issue` is `null` and `error` is `tracker_outcome_unknown` (never retryable; reconcile, do not resend under a new key). Failures a caller can act on before anything is written (`invalid_request` with the closed `details.reason` values, `caller_not_authorized`, `project_not_enabled`) are returned as the `{"error": ...}` envelope, not as this record.
